fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human name for this on-screen HUD element, e.g. 'Health bar', 'XP bar', 'Chain-tier banner', 'Wave counter'.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: Stable identifier for the element, usually matching its node / method in ui/hud.gd (e.g. 'health_bar', 'xp_bar', 'chain_banner').

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Kind
fields.description: Control kind: 'bar' (a fill / progress meter), 'counter' (a numeric readout), 'banner' (a transient toast / announcement), 'pip' (a discrete stamina / charge pip), 'icon' (a status glyph).

fields.name: bindTo
fields.title: Bind to
fields.description: The game state or signal this element reads, e.g. 'PlayerStats.health', 'PlayerStats.xp', 'Coordinator chain tier', 'player.stamina', 'wave_manager.current_wave'.

fields.name: style
fields.title: Style
fields.description: AAA-minimal styling note per the port UI philosophy — hierarchy + restraint + one accent, not flat all-cyan. E.g. 'cyan accent fill on near-black plate', 'hairline rule, no glow'.
